sam: Heads-up team  Priya resigned this morning, last day 2026-07-02 (Fri). Can People Ops kick off offboard and benefits timeline?

taylor (People Ops): Sorry to hear. I'll own checklist. Need Priya's personal email and whether she wants paper or e-delivery for COBRA/401k.

priya (via sam): Personal email = priya.kar@proton.me. Prefers electronic docs.

nina (Benefits): Coverage active until 07/02 23:59 PT. COBRA notice emailed within 3 business days. FSA runout ends 09/30. We'll include 401k rollover options.

frank (IT): Equipment list? Laptop, charger, work phone (SIM), parking tag, YubiKey. Propose deprovision at 18:00 PT on 07/02. Can arrange pickup 07/03 or ship return label.

olivia (Security): Quick audit: tag secrets with owner=priya and list service accounts. I'll revoke personal AWS keys at deprovision time.

maria (Payroll): Final pay on next monthly cycle 07/31 includes PTO payout. If Priya has unpaid expenses, file by 07/05 to include.

taylor (People Ops): Scheduling exit interview: Tue 06/30 9am PT or Thu 07/01 3pm PT. Priya which?

sam: Priya prefers 06/30 morning. Taylor please send invite to her personal email.

offboard-bot: Equipment ticket RX-4721 created. Reminder scheduled for 2026-07-03.

frank (IT): Also note: remove GitHub org membership and rotate any shared keys in repos Priya owned. Ask manager to list ownerships.

sam: Priya owns `auth-proxy` and `billing-adapter`. I'll put a transfer doc in the repo by EOD.

olivia (Security): If Priya had any customer credentials, mark them for rotation immediately after snapshot.

taylor (People Ops): Action recap: send COBRA + 401k emails, schedule exit interview 06/30 9am PT, create equipment ticket RX-4721, coordinate account disable 07/02 18:00 PT, payroll noted. I'll update thread.

priya (via sam): Thanks everyone  I'll complete equipment form and submit expense claims today.

maria (Payroll): Sent final pay estimate to Priya's personal email.

sam: Thanks team. Keep me posted if anything blocks the 07/02 timeline.
